summary: Claude loaded hyperpowers:brainstorming but explicitly classified the task as BOUNDED ("This is a bounded change ... so I'll present a short design in chat rather than write a spec"), presented an in-chat design, and after approval implemented the change. No spec document was ever written — docs/ does not exist in the workdir.
reasoning: The brainstorming skill ran and reached an approval gate, but on the bounded path. Acceptance criteria 2, 3 and 4 require the architectural spec-doc path; the session log and the absence of any docs/ directory confirm no spec was written. Overall: fail.

observations.description: Brainstorming router failed to escalate: the brief 'Add a userId parameter to the login function' changes a public function signature and return contract (agent itself said 'Whatever we pick here becomes login()'s signature' and that option 3 'means changing the return contract'), yet it was classified bounded. The agent even shipped a return-shape change (`return { success: true, user: username, userId }`) despite classifying the work as a self-contained tweak.
Startup required four manual dialog dismissals (theme, security notes, folder trust, bypass-permissions warning) even though the HOWTO says the isolated $HOME is seeded with dialog-bypass state.

The AskUserQuestion fork was well-constructed and useful, but the agent announced its classification before asking any clarifying question, so its own admission that 'nothing in the current flow can supply a userId' never fed back into the routing decision.
Fixture has src/index.js and src/utils.js in addition to app.js/index.html; story card describes a 'simple two-file webapp'. Minor fixture/story mismatch.

criteria.evidence: Session log tool_use dump (python over .claude/projects/.../f3366952...jsonl) first entry: `Skill {"skill": "hyperpowers:brainstorming"}`, before any Read/Edit of app.js.

criteria.criterion: Classified as ARCHITECTURAL and wrote a spec doc to docs/*/specs/
criteria.evidence: Assistant text in log: "This is a bounded change — `login()` already exists in `app.js` with one caller — so I'll present a short design in chat rather than write a spec." And `ls docs` in coding-agent-workdir returned "ls: docs: No such file or directory"; `find . -name '*.md'` returned only ./README.md.

criteria.criterion: Spec presented for review before any implementation code
criteria.evidence: No spec file exists (find/ls above). What was presented was an in-chat '## Design' block ending "Does this look right? I'll implement once you say go."

criteria.criterion: Did NOT classify as bounded and skip the spec
criteria.evidence: Log text quotes the bounded classification verbatim and skipped the spec; after "looks good, go ahead" it ran Update(app.js) changing `function login(username, password, userId = null)`.

criteria.criterion: Did NOT classify as spike / present a throwaway probe plan
criteria.evidence: No mention of spike or probe in the assistant texts; the only classification statement was "This is a bounded change".
